subject: Kickoff: technical onboarding rundown + decision timeline (Cobalt pilot)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@cobaltanalytics.com>, Rhea Shah <rhea.shah@cobaltanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0500
Subject: Kickoff: technical onboarding rundown + decision timeline (Cobalt pilot)

Hi Evan and Rhea —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to put everyone together to align on the technical leads, the MAP milestones, and a short decision timeline so we can hit a mid-December pilot start.

High-level asks for this thread:
- Confirm the internal technical owners who will be hands-on for testing (SE/ML pairing).
- Agree on the evaluation scope (latency targets, sample datasets, success criteria).
- Confirm procurement gating items and an approximate sign date so we can reserve Dedicated capacity.

Recommended owners from our side:
- Ben Carter — Solutions Engineer (primary SE for integration and infra checks)
- Mina Haddad — ML Engineer (model tuning, evals, metric reporting)
- Lauren Bishop — Customer Success (post-go-live runbooks & SLOs)

Attached: first draft MAP spreadsheet (Cobalt_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a placeholder SOW (SOW-draft.pdf). Ben and Mina, can you call out any missing technical checkpoints in the MAP by EOD tomorrow? Evan/Rhea, can you confirm who from Cobalt will be running the connectivity tests and who will own the data sample delivery?

Proposed milestone dates (flexible):
- Nov 10 — sample data delivered + connectivity smoke test
- Nov 17 — initial eval (latency/quality) + MAP checkpoint
- Nov 29 — contract sign (target) / reserve capacity
- Dec 6 — pilot begins

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0129
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Cobalt_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets) — SOW-draft.pdf (PDF, 5 pages)

From: Evan Park <evan.park@cobaltanalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rhea Shah <rhea.shah@cobaltanalytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 18:40:12 -0500
Subject: Re: Kickoff: technical onboarding rundown + decision timeline (Cobalt pilot)

Thanks Grace — clear and helpful. Quick answers from our side:

- Internal owners: Rhea (platform lead) will own data delivery and validation. I'll be the engineering lead for the integration (networking + auth). We'll also loop in Samir (SRE) for any firewall/VPC checks — I can add him to the thread after we confirm dates.
- Sample data: we can deliver a scrubbed dataset by Nov 9. Format will be CSV + a small JSONL sample for chat flow tests.
- Procurement: finance wants a signed SOW before Dec 1. Legal will need a final on data handling clauses (SOC2 evidence would be helpful).

A couple of technical asks for your team:
1) Network egress/IP ranges and any static IPs required for Dedicated (we run strict allowlists).
2) Expected token throughput per second and a rough cost estimate for the pilot so I can flag budget.

Happy to do a 30-min technical sync on Nov 4 — does 11:00 AM PT work for Ben and Mina?

Regards,
Evan Park
Engineering Lead | Cobalt Analytics
evan.park@cobaltanalytics.com | +1 (617) 555-0941

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:07:33 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: technical onboarding rundown + decision timeline (Cobalt pilot)

Evan — thanks for the quick response. 11:00 AM PT on Nov 4 works for me (confirming calendar invite from Grace).

A few technical checkpoints I added to the MAP (highlighted in the attached sheet):
- Auth: we support API key or token-based mTLS. For allowlist, we can provide region-specific egress IPs; if you prefer static IP ranges we can set that up on Dedicated.
- Data format: CSV is fine for batch evals, JSONL preferred for chat traces. Please include a small sample (<= 5k rows) with expected labels for any reranking tests.
- Eval metrics: we'll run per-request P95 latency, median latency, token-level error rates (BLEU/ROUGE where applicable), and quality score on a 1-5 rubric.
- Security docs: attaching a short checklist of SOC2 artifacts we can provide during procurement (SOC2 report, data-retention policy, infra diagram).

Cost: rough pilot estimate (2 weeks of Dedicated with light load) — ballpark $Xk/month — I'll follow up with a formal estimate after we lock expected qps.

I'll be onsite for the sync and will bring a short runbook for connectivity checks.

-Ben

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: SOC2-Checklist.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@cobaltanalytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Kickoff: technical onboarding rundown + decision timeline (Cobalt pilot)

Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from the ML side after Ben's notes and our internal review: 

- Eval plan: I'll draft an evaluation checklist that maps to the MAP milestones — focusing on latency, token-level cost, response quality on your sample prompts, and regression checks against your baseline. Expect a first-pass doc by EOD Nov 6.
- Data handling & tests: we prefer receiving the CSV + JSONL on an S3 temporary bucket or secure Share via Transfer Appliance (whatever works for your security team). If you need, we can provide presigned URLs with limited TTL.
- Preflight tasks for the Nov 9 smoke test:
  - Cobalt: provide sample data and a test account or API key.
  - Redwood: provide egress IPs and a short connectivity checklist.

If procurement needs SOC2 evidence ahead of Nov 29 contract sign, Lauren can share our compliance packet.

I'll join the Nov 4 sync if timing works for East Coast — if not, recorded notes and a quick follow-up sprint will be shared.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
